confirmed_root_causes.detail: Football ledger accepts a broad worldwide fixture population while COR02/COR03 tennis is intentionally restricted to ATP Challenger Hard singles. The counters are therefore not expected to grow at the same raw rate.

The tennis static cut was seeded from only 96 exact-cut Challenger rows / 121 passing players. Future qualifiers and lower-frequency players often arrive outside that registry and must be resolved reactively.

A player can have a stable provider ID/name/DOB/hand/source-id while historical IOC differs from ranking-cut IOC. Marko Topo was blocked with historical GER versus cut SRB despite strong deterministic identity evidence.

rank_diff and rank_points_diff are mandatory model features. Eleven of twenty 04-Oct domain candidates were rejected at discovery, primarily because an exact 21-Sep ranking row could not be resolved for at least one player.

155 physical frozen rows map to 96 unique calibration observations; 59 duplicate/alias rows are quarantined. Current dedupe prevents those rows from inflating the calibration denominator, but legacy/provider ID drift consumed throughput.

Some Challenger matches start shortly after 00:00 Bogota. Discovery/identity work performed too close to match start can produce EVENT_NOT_FUTURE or POST_START_FREEZE_FORBIDDEN. Football more often freezes multiple days ahead.

correction_executed.description: Permit a governed IOC transition only when provider ID, exact dated ranking, name, unique pre-cut source-id, fixed hand and unique DOB all agree; no name-only join, no outcomes, no post-cut competitive fields.

next_architecture_actions: Build a proactive sealed PIT player authority for every player appearing in the forward Challenger-Hard calendar, before match day, instead of relying on the 121-player exact-cut static registry.
Resolve exact 21-Sep ranking, stable provider IDs, biography and pre-cut Challenger history as soon as a draw appears; persist BLOCKED causes explicitly when no legal PIT source exists.
Move identity/history preparation to the forward horizon so Asian/qualifying matches are freeze-ready before local midnight.
Keep physical-event dedupe before preregistration/model execution across both paid APIs.

Keep COR02/COR03 ATP-Challenger-Hard immutable; if higher tennis throughput is desired, create separate governed calibration lanes for other surfaces/circuits rather than contaminating the 600-match holdout.
